title: A reader of origin/roadmap fetches it before its verdict
why: Two readers judge from a stale local origin/roadmap and never fetch: hooks/feedback_guard.py line 138, and lint/ruled_store.py STORE_REF "origin/roadmap". Incident: fb-0950-4 was refused at 09:53 CST Nov 13 on a stale ref. LANE REPORT 09:52 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 09:51, from lane roadmap-ref-fresh, #3253; its own account, unread by the coordinator and triage): its fresh round 1 (haiku) on head 50b5b5e1e9 FAILED on a real hole: fresh_ref counts any recent FETCH_HEAD roadmap line as fresh without checking that its sha equals origin/roadmap's tip. The lane fixes it; review restarts at round 1 on the new head. Coordinator's pick on the lane's question, its own and undoable: the other readers stay debts and are not routed into #3253. The debts are filed as step readers-use-fresh-ref.
source: retrospective 09:55 CST Nov 13; owner "isn't this a problem itself too?"
note: Fix: one shared reader runs a bounded 2 s `git fetch origin roadmap` when the ref is old; on timeout it adds "read as of <time>" to its verdict. Both readers call it. Done when: one test shows a stale ref fetched and passing; one with no network shows the note. Group "sessions stay current" (10:05 CST Nov 13): see step merge-mail-refreshes-sessions.
